scholarships.title: Australia Awards Fellowships
scholarships.official_source: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT), Australian Government

eligibility: Australian Host Organisation must be a legal entity with current ABN.
Overseas Counterpart Organisation must operate in an eligible ODA country.
Fellows must not be Australian citizens or permanent residents.
Fellows must be citizens of and residing in an eligible developing country.
Fellows must have relevant professional experience.
Fellows must be able to participate for the full duration.
existing.eligibility_summary: Australian organisations (with ABN) partner with Overseas Counterpart Organisations (OCOs) in eligible developing countries to host Fellows. Fellows must be 18+, citizens of eligible ODA countries, not Australian citizens or permanent residents, and meet visa requirements.
benefits: Up to AUD 34,500 per Fellow (competitive grant to Australian organisation)
Australian organisation must provide co-contribution (in-kind or financial)
coverage: Up to AUD 34,500 per Fellow (competitive grant to Australian organisation)
Australian organisation must provide co-contribution (in-kind or financial)
documents: Organisation ABN and legal entity details
application_method: Online via SmartyGrants portal (Australian organisations only)
existing.best_fit: Australian organisations seeking to host mid-career professionals from developing countries for short-term development programs.
existing.notes: Round 21 closed 16 January 2026. Round 22 expected to open in Q4 2026. Individuals cannot apply directly; applications are submitted by Australian host organisations only. Activities must include a minimum of 2 weeks in Australia, with total duration 2–52 weeks.
existing.application_period: Round-dependent; Round 21 closed 16 January 2026; Round 22 expected to open Q4 2026

scholarships.title: University of Sydney Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme

existing.description: Five scholarship amounts are offered based on your ranking against the selection criteria:
eligibility: Applied for but not yet commenced a CRICOS-registered bachelor's or coursework master's degree at the University of Sydney.
Received an unconditional offer of admission by the relevant round close date.
existing.eligibility_summary: International student who has applied for but not yet commenced a CRICOS-registered bachelor's or coursework master's degree at the University of Sydney; must receive an unconditional offer of admission by the relevant round close date.
benefits: Payable in equal instalments per semester.
Recipients of Sydney International Student Award capped at AUD 40,000 maximum.
coverage: Payable in equal instalments per semester.
Recipients of Sydney International Student Award capped at AUD 40,000 maximum.
requirements: Receive an unconditional offer of admission by the relevant round close date
c. Applicants commencing a second degree at the University of Sydney are eligible provided they have not previously held the Vice Chancellor’s International Scholarships.
d. Recipients of scholarships provided by the Australian Government are not eligible.
ii. The recipient undertaking an exchange during the tenure of this Scholarship are required to have achieved a Satisfied Requirements grade (SR) to receive their next payment.
documents: Apply for admission to the University of Sydney.
No separate scholarship application required; automatic consideration for eligible students.
application_method: Automatic consideration upon receiving unconditional offer of admission
existing.selection_notes: b. The Scholarship will be awarded on the nomination of a selection committee consisting of two nominees of the Executive Director, Sydney Future Students and one nominee of the Admissions Office.
existing.best_fit: Exceptional international students commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework at the University of Sydney.
existing.notes: Five scholarship tiers awarded based on academic merit ranking. From 2026 intakes, additional $60,000 tier introduced and Sydney International Student Award cap increased to $40,000. Scholarship is one-time, awarded during first year of commencement, not renewable for subsequent years.
existing.duration: One year (paid in two equal instalments per semester) or one semester, depending on the award amount
existing.application_period: Round-dependent; e.g., Semester 1 2027: Round 1 closes 17 Aug 2026, Round 2 closes 5 Oct 2026, Round 3 closes 16 Nov 2026
existing.deadline_display: No application required. Eligible students who secure an unconditional offer of admission by the relevant close date are automatically considered. Semester 1, 2027 offer rounds close 17 August 2026, 5 October 2026 and 16 November 2026; Semester 2, 2027 rounds close 15 February 2027, 22 March 2027 and 3 May 2027.
existing.program_type: Post-admission merit scholarship for international coursework students
